title: MewType
overview: A band activity that starts suddenly. There's a reason she wants to run away from "singing"... Even so, the story begins to move relentlessly.

title: Smooch!
overview: An era where a single word can lead to a social media firestorm. Words intended to protect end up hurting someone. Even so, she says with a smile—

title: Suit Yourself!
overview: The relationship moves forward, but that's all. As a band, nothing has started yet. And then, another encounter arrives—

title: Might Be Fun
overview: The activities of the four members seem to be going smoothly. However, a relationship that was supposed to be distant begins to move. Feelings that were being ignored start to seep out—

title: Help
overview: Pretending to be okay, pretending to be energetic. That sense of unease can no longer be hidden. Far away, a single gear begins to shift out of place--

title: Destiny
overview: Apologizing, feeling depressed, thinking everything was ruined. It's still continuing. It's not over yet. Can they truly face each other once more?

title: Turning Over a New Leaf
overview: At that time, one was chosen. Beyond that, the scenery changes just a little. But, that doesn't mean everything will go well.

title: Gold Star
overview: There is a desire to help. But that alone isn't enough. By the time you realize it, it might already be too late—

title: Disbandment
overview: One leaves, one holds on, one steps forward, and one stands still. The other one-- hasn't been able to choose anything yet. They might not be able to go back anymore--

title: Sea
overview: Swaying, colliding, and the shape begins to crumble. I don't want it to end here. Even if I'm swept away, I will find it properly.

title: That Was Fun
overview: If we stay close, it's truly warm. If we hadn't separated, it should have been fine. But—that fire will no longer stop.

title: Goodbye
overview: Warmth alone is not enough to convey. If you stay silent, nothing will change. So—I won't run away.
